metric_definitions.gradient_energy: sum of mean squared first differences over phi/theta/r
metric_definitions.radial_profile: mean over phi/theta at every r center
metric_definitions.retention: numerator metric / denominator metric; null at configured floor
metric_definitions.shells: eight frozen physical-r shells; no batch/channel aggregation
metric_definitions.total_variation: mean of mean absolute first differences over phi/theta/r
metric_definitions.variance: population variance (ddof=0) over one channel and phi/theta/r
